_frozen: 2026-09-07 setup pass; values fixed BEFORE execution and may not be changed after inspecting any result
_classification_note: Every key is classified: PHYSICAL_INPUT (inherited from the record), NUMERICAL (computational parameter, no physical content), or CONTROL (battery configuration).

physical._m2_note: BARE mass zero: this is the unlifted-zero-mode starting point. Any relaxation in the primary run must be GENERATED by the self-interaction, not supplied.
physical._lambda_note: lambda=0.01 => sqrt(lambda)=0.1 => the record's m_eff^2 = 0.1 H^2 via the SY dynamical-mass rule (RESULTS_conformalon.md). This is the record's own referent value, not a tuned choice.

numerical._class: NUMERICAL -- computational parameters; no physical content; none is a new scale
numerical._fit_windows_note: THREE preregistered windows for the O1b cross-check. Chosen EX ANTE from: (i) the analytic ensemble-mean noise floor sigma_phi/sqrt(N) with sigma_phi from the SY closed-form stationary variance, (ii) the two already-identified candidate rates, and (iii) the predetermined detectability criterion SNR >= 5 at every window end, evaluated against the FASTER candidate (the binding case). No stochastic result existed when these were fixed and none may reopen them.
numerical._ac_note: Autocorrelation route O1a (PRIMARY): 400 stationary trajectories, lags to 150 Hubble times. Stationary averaging has no SNR cliff, which the ensemble-mean decay fit does.
numerical._n_traj_note: 4000. The primary estimator is the stationary autocorrelation, which has no ensemble-mean SNR cliff; n_traj is therefore set by the cross-check windows, which are SNR-safe at 4000 (see _fit_windows_note). Not raised further, to keep the horizon extension affordable.
numerical._t_max_note: 600 Hubble times so the burn-in (50% = 300) exceeds ~2.7 relaxation times of the SLOWER preregistered target (1/k_B = 113): the autocorrelation route requires genuine stationarity for BOTH candidates, not just the faster one. Fixed ex ante from the two candidate rates.

tolerances._class: DESIGN DECISION -- declared explicitly for review; frozen before execution
tolerances._note: No defensible threshold exists in the record for these; they are design decisions, stated here rather than hidden in code, and may not be relaxed after seeing results.
tolerances._window_note: max relative spread of the three decay-fit rates for CONVERGED
